title: Wi-Fi Security & Public Wi-Fi Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your public Wi-Fi security risk level and get personalized tips to protect your data on unsecured networks and hotspots.
description: Assess your vulnerability when using public Wi-Fi networks and get personalized security recommendations. This calculator evaluates network types, your browsing habits, and security measures to determine your risk level.

formula: const networkRisk = { 'open-public': 40, 'password-public': 30, 'hotel': 25, 'cafe': 30, 'airport': 35, 'enterprise': 10 }; const vpnProtection = { 'always': -30, 'sometimes': -15, 'never': 0 }; const activityRisk = { 'basic': 10, 'mixed': 20, 'sensitive': 35, 'high-risk': 40 }; const securityBonus = { 'none': 0, 'basic': -5, 'moderate': -10, 'advanced': -15 }; const durationRisk = { 'short': 5, 'moderate': 10, 'long': 15 }; const deviceBonus = { 'basic': 0, 'moderate': -5, 'high': -10 }; let riskScore = networkRisk[networkType] + vpnProtection[vpnUsage] + activityRisk[browsingSensitivity] + securityBonus[securityMeasures] + durationRisk[connectionDuration] + deviceBonus[deviceSecurity]; riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, riskScore)); let riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'High Risk': riskScore >= 40 ? 'Medium Risk': riskScore >= 20 ? 'Low Risk': 'Very Low Risk'; let vulnerabilities = []; if (networkType === 'open-public') vulnerabilities.push('Unencrypted network traffic'); if (vpnUsage === 'never') vulnerabilities.push('No VPN protection'); if (browsingSensitivity === 'sensitive' || browsingSensitivity === 'high-risk') vulnerabilities.push('Sensitive data exposure'); if (securityMeasures === 'none') vulnerabilities.push('Minimal security measures'); return { riskScore: riskScore, riskLevel: riskLevel, vulnerabilities: vulnerabilities.join(', ') || 'Good security posture' };

educational.methodology: This calculator assesses your public Wi-Fi risk by evaluating network security, your protective measures, activity sensitivity, and exposure duration. Scores range from 0-100, with higher scores indicating greater vulnerability to attacks like man-in-the-middle, data interception, and malicious hotspots.
tips: Always use a reputable VPN when connecting to public Wi-Fi networks to encrypt your traffic
Disable auto-connect features and forget networks after use to prevent automatic connections to malicious hotspots
Only visit HTTPS websites and avoid accessing sensitive accounts like banking on public networks
Use a privacy-focused browser or private browsing modes to minimize data collection and tracking
Keep your device's operating system and security software updated to protect against known vulnerabilities
